summary_md: **3/3, 100%, 😌 relaxed.** Read in **1:28** (107 words ≈ 73 wpm by the timer – short scene with dialogue and the notes table, so the number is less reliable than in 04/05, where you were at ~121–124).
asks_md:
**"Does my slow reading affect my listening?"** – Yes, they're connected, and that's good news:
- Both need the same thing: **recognising words instantly** and joining them into ideas. In listening the speaker sets the speed (~150–160 wpm); if your brain processes at ~120, the long narrator sentences run ahead of you – exactly what you felt in 06.
- So **every bit of faster reading also helps your ears**, and **reading while listening** trains both at once (the voice pulls your eyes forward at speech speed).
- You're already moving: 100 → 121–124 wpm in two days. When reading reaches ~150+, story narration will feel much calmer.

🇻🇳 Đúng là liên quan: nghe và đọc cùng cần nhận ra từ tức thì. Người nói ~150–160 từ/phút; não xử lý ~120 thì câu dẫn chuyện dài sẽ chạy trước Tân. Đọc nhanh lên thì nghe cũng dễ hơn – và đọc kèm nghe luyện cả hai.
